note: October closed at 12,229 create-path GA4 bookings against a 16,579 target and 11,874 in September. Read the target as reference only: London is framed week on week and year on year. The shape that matters is down 2.0 per cent year on year, and ex DSL down 13.2 per cent, because DSL trades against a pre-rebrand base of 95 bookings and is not comparable. Aqua Shard is the whole of the gap on its own, 5,631 against 6,872 last October, a fall of 1,241 against a portfolio shortfall of 245. Hutong at 3,768 against 3,403 is the only venue ahead of last year, up 10.7 per cent, and it is also the only venue other than Aqua Shard whose booking tag is collecting properly. Regent St at 708 against 1,177, Azzurra at 302 against 500 and Shiro Sushi at 333 against 427 are all behind, but all three under-recorded the booking event from the middle of the month, so those falls are measurement as much as trading and should be read as floors. Covers tell a better story than bookings across the market, so read this next to the weekly covers reports.
